# model:     ht
# outcome:   read
# source:    docs/HANDOFF.md (the 17:49:02 insert, addr-stamped from
#            AFC_BambuAMS.log) and docs/CAPTURE_FINDINGS.md "Spool capacity:
#            the AMS has the step, and on an HT it is switched off".
# verbatim:  abbreviated -- the four HANDOFF lines carry wall-clock stamps
#            rather than offsets, and the capacity lines come from a second
#            insert on the same unit.
#
# The HT's dialect is STEP + digit + COMMA where the boxed units use STEP +
# COLON. That single difference made _RFID_READ_OK_RE unable to match anything
# an HT ever said, and the unit was diagnosed as broken for four firmware
# rounds while it was answering correctly the whole time.
#
# Note the HT commits to its own flash and SAYS SO -- "save to flash ,card info
# valid" -- which is a stronger statement than a read landing. The boxed models
# say "[RF] trayN: info write to flash" for the same event; both spellings now
# count as a read.
#
# "tray capacity no en" is terminal on this model: the HT reaches the tray
# capacity step, declines to run it, and its cycle is over there. It never
# reaches the calibration a boxed unit ends on.
#
# offset | expect | line
- | .             | [AMS_RFID] STEP3,auth card successful
- | read inflight | [RF] tray0: info write to flash
- | read          | [AMS_RFID] STEP3,save to flash ,card info valid
- | read inflight | [AMS_RFID] STEP3,read success ,goto Cali
- | .             | [AMS_RFID] STEP,odom reset tray 0
- | read inflight | [AMS_RFID] STEP3,feed with rfid success
- | end           | [AMS_RFID] STEP3:tray capacity no en
- | end           | [AMS_RFID] STEP4,Calibration rst:0
